sloka: स सर्वा देवतास्त्यक्त्वा शक्रमेवाभ्यधावत ।महेन्द्रश्च महातेजा नापश्यच्च सुतं रिपोः ।। ७.२९.२४ ॥
transliteration: sa sarvā devatāstyaktvā śakramevābhyadhāvata ।mahendraśca mahātejā nāpaśyacca sutaṁ ripoḥ ।। 7.29.24 ॥

translations.english: Indrajit, disregarding all other gods, rushed only towards Indra, but the greatly effulgent Mahendra could not see the enemy's son.
